type.ruling: Oswald everywhere, UPPERCASE, wide tracking (titles 600 +8, buttons 600 +4). Numbers in Oswald 600 teal-white. Old Standard TT for longer prose only.

motion.flicker: on panel open, alpha 0 -> 1 -> 0.6 -> 1 over 160 ms (power-up flicker)
motion.scan: optional 1-px teal line sweeping down panels every 4 s

pairs_with: spades_bg (cool palette) or the kaleidoscope with col_c/col_d set to teal.
